title: IMMUNOHISTOCHEMICAL EVALUATION OF RABIES VIRUS DISSEMINATION TO PERIPHERAL TISSUES AND ORGANS IN NATURALLY INFECTED STRIPED SKUNKS (MEPHITIS MEPHITIS) FROM NORTHERN COLORADO, USA
abstract: We describe the diagnostic utility of peripheral tissues from naturally infected free-ranging rabid striped skunks (Mephitis mephitis) to explore enhanced rabies surveillance testing using alternative tissues to the brainstem. Fifty-two dead or moribund adult striped skunks were collected by the Larimer County Health Department (Colorado, USA) as part of routine public health rabies surveillance during November 2018–July 2019 throughout Larimer County. Skunk carcasses were submitted to the Colorado State University Diagnostic Laboratory for rabies diagnosis using the direct fluorescent antibody test on the brainstem at the level on the pons and cerebellum. Multiple additional tissues were opportunistically collected from skunk carcasses and fixed in 10% neutral-buffered formalin, including brain, trigeminal ganglion, mandibular and parotid salivary glands, eyes, tongue, lip (including vibrissa), ear pinna, and uterus and fetuses if pregnant. Fixed tissues were trimmed for histology, stained with H&E, and immunolabeled for detection of the rabies virus (RV) antigen. We detected RV immunopositive cells in multiple sections of brain, oral and nasal cavities, skin, and eyes as well as in the placenta and skin of fetuses from rabid skunks, suggesting the potential for transplacental transmission. We detected RV in the nerves and ganglia of salivary glands before detection in the salivary parenchymal cells in rabid skunks. The serous demilunes of the mandibular salivary gland appeared to be the first parenchymal cells to be infected with RV. We detected minimal RV immunopositive cells in the serous adenomeres of the parotid salivary gland and the mucous adenomeres of salivary tissue of the tongue. The results suggest that swabs from the oral and nasal cavities and cornea and biopsies of the skin could be of value for enhanced rabies surveillance in cases where the animal's brain has been destroyed or is unavailable.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the diagnostic utility of peripheral tissues for rabies surveillance, addressing the gap in traditional methods that rely on brainstem samples which may not always be available.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Fifty-two dead or moribund adult striped skunks were collected by the Larimer County Health Department during November 2018–July 2019 in Larimer County, Colorado, USA as part of routine public health rabies surveillance.

RV was detected in the nerves and ganglia of salivary glands before detection in the salivary parenchymal cells, with the serous demilunes of the mandibular salivary gland appearing to be the first parenchymal cells to be infected.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that alternative tissues such as the oral and nasal cavities, cornea, and skin may be useful for rabies surveillance when brainstem samples are unavailable, highlighting the potential for transplacental transmission.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results could inform enhanced rabies surveillance strategies by utilizing alternative tissues for diagnosis, particularly in cases where the brainstem is not available, thereby improving detection and response efforts.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on opportunistic tissue collection and the absence of control groups, which may affect the generalizability of the findings. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the dissemination of rabies virus in naturally infected striped skunks from northern Colorado, focusing on the diagnostic utility of peripheral tissues. Fifty-two dead or moribund skunks were collected during 2018–2019 for rabies surveillance. Tissues were collected and processed for histology and immunolabeling. RV immunopositive cells were detected in multiple tissues, including the brain, oral and nasal cavities, skin, eyes, and placenta, suggesting transplacental transmission. The serous demilunes of the mandibular salivary gland were the first parenchymal cells infected. The findings indicate that alternative tissues may be valuable for rabies surveillance when brainstem samples are unavailable. However, the study's reliance on opportunistic sampling and lack of control groups limit the strength of the evidence, which is considered moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨外周组织在 狂犬病 监测 中的诊断价值,以弥补传统方法依赖脑干样本而这些样本可能无法始终获得的不足。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2018 年 11 月至 2019 年 7 月期间,拉里默县卫生部门(美国科罗拉多州拉里默县)在常规公共卫生 狂犬病 监测 的过程中收集了 52 只死亡或濒死的成年带纹浣熊。
elements_zh.methods: 浣熊尸体被提交用于 狂犬病 诊断 检测,使用直接荧光抗体试验在脑干进行检测,同时机会性采集了多种其他组织,并用 10% 中性缓冲福尔马林固定。固定组织被修剪用于组织学检查,用苏木精和伊红(H&E)染色,并进行免疫标记以检测 狂犬病病毒(RV)抗原。
elements_zh.main_results: 在狂犬病浣熊的多个脑部、口腔和鼻腔、皮肤和眼睛组织切片中检测到了RV免疫阳性细胞,以及在胎儿的胎盘和皮肤中也发现了RV阳性细胞。RV在腮腺神经和神经节中被检测到,早于其在腮腺实质细胞中的检测,其中下颌腮腺的浆液性半月形结构似乎是最先被感染的实质细胞。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,当脑干样本不可用时,口腔和鼻腔、角膜以及皮肤等替代组织可能对 狂犬病 监测 有帮助,突显了经胎盘传播的潜在可能性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能通过利用替代组织进行 诊断 检测,从而为增强 狂犬病 监测 策略提供信息,特别是在脑干不可用的情况下,这将有助于提高检测和应对努力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于依赖机会性组织采集,并且缺乏对照组,这可能影响研究结果的普遍适用性。由于这些限制,证据强度中等。

analysis_en.methods: Skunk carcasses were submitted for rabies diagnosis using the direct fluorescent antibody test on the brainstem, and multiple additional tissues were opportunistically collected and fixed in 10% neutral-buffered formalin. Fixed tissues were trimmed for histology, stained with H&E, and immunolabeled for detection of the rabies virus (RV) antigen.
analysis_en.main_results: RV immunopositive cells were detected in multiple sections of brain, oral and nasal cavities, skin, and eyes, as well as in the placenta and skin of fetuses from rabid skunks. RV was detected in the nerves and ganglia of salivary glands before detection in the salivary parenchymal cells, with the serous demilunes of the mandibular salivary gland appearing to be the first parenchymal cells to be infected.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that alternative tissues such as the oral and nasal cavities, cornea, and skin may be useful for rabies surveillance when brainstem samples are unavailable, highlighting the potential for transplacental transmission.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results could inform enhanced rabies surveillance strategies by utilizing alternative tissues for diagnosis, particularly in cases where the brainstem is not available, thereby improving detection and response efforts.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on opportunistic tissue collection and the absence of control groups, which may affect the generalizability of the findings. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these limitations.

title_zh: 狂犬病病毒 在美国科罗拉多州北部自然感染条纹臭鼬(Mephitis mephitis)中向周围组织和器官的传播的免疫组织化学评估
source_body_en: We describe the diagnostic utility of peripheral tissues from naturally infected free-ranging rabid striped skunks (Mephitis mephitis) to explore enhanced rabies surveillance testing using alternative tissues to the brainstem. Fifty-two dead or moribund adult striped skunks were collected by the Larimer County Health Department (Colorado, USA) as part of routine public health rabies surveillance during November 2018–July 2019 throughout Larimer County. Skunk carcasses were submitted to the Colorado State University Diagnostic Laboratory for rabies diagnosis using the direct fluorescent antibody test on the brainstem at the level on the pons and cerebellum. Multiple additional tissues were opportunistically collected from skunk carcasses and fixed in 10% neutral-buffered formalin, including brain, trigeminal ganglion, mandibular and parotid salivary glands, eyes, tongue, lip (including vibrissa), ear pinna, and uterus and fetuses if pregnant. Fixed tissues were trimmed for histology, stained with H&E, and immunolabeled for detection of the rabies virus (RV) antigen. We detected RV immunopositive cells in multiple sections of brain, oral and nasal cavities, skin, and eyes as well as in the placenta and skin of fetuses from rabid skunks, suggesting the potential for transplacental transmission. We detected RV in the nerves and ganglia of salivary glands before detection in the salivary parenchymal cells in rabid skunks. The serous demilunes of the mandibular salivary gland appeared to be the first parenchymal cells to be infected with RV. We detected minimal RV immunopositive cells in the serous adenomeres of the parotid salivary gland and the mucous adenomeres of salivary tissue of the tongue. The results suggest that swabs from the oral and nasal cavities and cornea and biopsies of the skin could be of value for enhanced rabies surveillance in cases where the animal's brain has been destroyed or is unavailable.
abstract_zh: 我们描述了从自然感染的野生狂犬病带纹浣熊(Mephitis mephitis)中采集的外周组织在诊断中的应用价值,以探索使用替代脑干组织进行增强型 狂犬病 监测 检测的可行性。2018 年 11 月至 2019 年 7 月期间,拉里默县卫生部门(美国科罗拉多州)在拉里默县收集了 52 只死亡或濒死的成年带纹浣熊,作为常规公共卫生 狂犬病 监测 的一部分。这些浣熊尸体被提交至科罗拉多州立大学诊断实验室,使用直接荧光抗体试验在脑干(桥脑和小脑)水平检测 狂犬病 诊断。从浣熊尸体中机会性采集了多种其他组织,并用 10% 中性缓冲福尔马林固定,包括脑、三叉神经节、下颌和腮腺唾液腺、眼睛、舌头、唇(包括胡须)、耳廓以及子宫和胎儿(如果怀孕)。固定组织被修剪用于组织学检查,用苏木精和伊红(H&E)染色,并进行免疫标记以检测 狂犬病病毒(RV)抗原。我们在狂犬病浣熊的脑、口腔和鼻腔、皮肤和眼睛的多个切片中检测到 RV 免疫阳性细胞,以及在胎儿的胎盘和皮肤中也检测到 RV,这表明可能存在经胎盘传播的 传播。我们在狂犬病浣熊的唾液腺神经和神经节中检测到 RV,早于在唾液腺实质细胞中的检测。下颌唾液腺的浆液性半月形似乎是最先被 RV 感染的实质细胞。我们在腮腺唾液腺的浆液性腺瘤和舌头唾液组织的黏液性腺瘤中检测到少量 RV 免疫阳性细胞。结果表明,当动物的脑干不可用或已被破坏时,从口腔和鼻腔、角膜以及皮肤进行拭子采集和活检可能对增强 狂犬病 监测 有帮助,突显了经胎盘传播的潜在可能性。
summary_zh: 我们描述了从自然感染的野生狂犬病带纹浣熊(Mephitis mephitis)中采集的外周组织在诊断中的应用价值,以探索使用替代脑干组织进行增强型 狂犬病 监测 检测的可行性。2018 年 11 月至 2019 年 7 月期间,拉里默县卫生部门(美国科罗拉多州)在拉里默县收集了 52 只死亡或濒死的成年带纹浣熊,作为常规公共卫生 狂犬病 监测 的一部分。这些浣熊尸体被提交至科罗拉多州立大学诊断实验室,使用直接荧光抗体试验在脑干(桥脑和小脑)水平检测 狂犬病 诊断。从浣熊尸体中机会性采集了多种其他组织,并用 10% 中性缓冲福尔马林固定,包括脑、三叉神经节、下颌和腮腺唾液腺、眼睛、舌头、唇(包括胡须)、耳廓以及子宫和胎儿(如果怀孕)。固定组织被修剪用于组织学检查,用苏木精和伊红(H&E)染色,并进行免疫标记以检测 狂犬病病毒(RV)抗原。我们在狂犬病浣熊的脑、口腔和鼻腔、皮肤和眼睛的多个切片中检测到 RV 免疫阳性细胞,以及在胎儿的胎盘和皮肤中也检测到 RV,这表明可能存在经胎盘传播的 传播。我们在狂犬病浣熊的唾液腺神经和神经节中检测到 RV,早于在唾液腺实质细胞中的检测。下颌唾液腺的浆液性半月形似乎是最先被 RV 感染的实质细胞。我们在腮腺唾液腺的浆液性腺瘤和舌头唾液组织的黏液性腺瘤中检测到少量 RV 免疫阳性细胞。结果表明,当动物的脑干不可用或已被破坏时,从口腔和鼻腔、角膜以及皮肤进行拭子采集和活检可能对增强 狂犬病 监测 有帮助,突显了经胎盘传播的潜在可能性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨外周组织在 狂犬病 监测 中的诊断价值,以弥补传统方法依赖脑干样本而这些样本可能无法始终获得的不足。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2018 年 11 月至 2019 年 7 月期间,拉里默县卫生部门(美国科罗拉多州拉里默县)在常规公共卫生 狂犬病 监测 的过程中收集了 52 只死亡或濒死的成年带纹浣熊。
analysis_zh.methods: 浣熊尸体被提交用于 狂犬病 诊断 检测,使用直接荧光抗体试验在脑干进行检测,同时机会性采集了多种其他组织,并用 10% 中性缓冲福尔马林固定。固定组织被修剪用于组织学检查,用苏木精和伊红(H&E)染色,并进行免疫标记以检测 狂犬病病毒(RV)抗原。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在狂犬病浣熊的多个脑部、口腔和鼻腔、皮肤和眼睛组织切片中检测到了RV免疫阳性细胞,以及在胎儿的胎盘和皮肤中也发现了RV阳性细胞。RV在腮腺神经和神经节中被检测到,早于其在腮腺实质细胞中的检测,其中下颌腮腺的浆液性半月形结构似乎是最先被感染的实质细胞。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,当脑干样本不可用时,口腔和鼻腔、角膜以及皮肤等替代组织可能对 狂犬病 监测 有帮助,突显了经胎盘传播的潜在可能性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能通过利用替代组织进行 诊断 检测,从而为增强 狂犬病 监测 策略提供信息,特别是在脑干不可用的情况下,这将有助于提高检测和应对努力。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于依赖机会性组织采集,并且缺乏对照组,这可能影响研究结果的普遍适用性。由于这些限制,证据强度中等。

title: When War Breaks the Human-Dog Bond: Armed Conflict and the Resurgence of Rabies.
abstract: Impacts Armed conflict is rising globally; however, its more‐than‐human dimensions are rarely examined. Dog‐human entanglements are profoundly impacted by armed conflict, with implications for health and wellbeing for humans, dogs and the broader environment. This includes the transmission of infections that dogs can spread to humans‐with rabies being the most serious of these‐and injury due to dog bites. Dogs and their relationships to humans, especially children, must be factored into humanitarian response and planning.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the impact of armed conflict on rabies transmission and the human-dog relationship, highlighting the need to understand how such conflicts disrupt public health and animal welfare.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is an editorial that examines global armed conflict trends and their effects on rabies, focusing on the human-dog bond and the associated health risks in affected regions.
analysis.methods: The editorial synthesizes existing literature and data on armed conflict, rabies transmission, and the role of dogs in public health, without detailing specific methodologies or statistical analyses.
analysis.main_results: The editorial reports that armed conflict disrupts the human-dog bond, leading to increased rabies transmission risks and potential injury from dog bites, with rabies being the most serious infection dogs can spread to humans.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that armed conflict exacerbates rabies risks by destabilizing human-dog relationships, offering a novel perspective on the intersection of public health, animal welfare, and conflict.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the need to integrate canine health and safety into humanitarian planning, particularly in conflict zones where rabies transmission and dog bite injuries are heightened.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on an editorial, which may lack empirical data, and the conclusions are not supported by specific statistical analyses, resulting in moderate confidence.

analysis.summary_en: This editorial explores the impact of armed conflict on the human-dog bond and its implications for rabies transmission and public health. It highlights how conflict disrupts the relationship between humans and dogs, increasing the risk of rabies and dog bites. The authors argue that these factors must be considered in humanitarian planning and response. While the study provides a novel perspective on the intersection of conflict, animal welfare, and disease, it is based on a synthesis of existing literature rather than original empirical data, limiting the strength of its evidence to moderate.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一篇社论,分析全球武装冲突趋势及其对狂犬病的影响,重点关注受影响地区的人与狗纽带及其相关的健康风险。
elements_zh.methods: 该社论综合了关于武装冲突、狂犬病以及狗在公共卫生中的作用的现有文献和数据,未详细说明具体的方法或统计分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 该社论报告称,武装冲突会破坏人与狗之间的纽带,导致狂犬病风险增加以及狗咬造成的潜在伤害,其中狂犬病是狗传播给人类的最严重感染。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,武装冲突通过破坏人与狗的关系加剧了狂犬病的风险,提供了关于公共卫生、动物福利和冲突交叉点的新视角。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,需要将犬类健康和安全纳入人道主义规划,特别是在冲突地区,狂犬病和狗咬伤害的风险更高。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据基于一篇社论,可能缺乏实证数据,且结论未得到具体统计分析的支持,因此置信度中等。

title: Stray dog culling for rabies control: a stochastic modelling study.
abstract: A stochastic continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) model, rooted in a deterministic approach, investigates rabies dynamics within human and stray dog populations. Stability analysis confirms the disease-free equilibrium is globally asymptotically stable for Re 1. Through a Galton-Watson branching process, the stochastic threshold is derived, providing extinction probabilities that align closely with 10,000 numerical sample paths. The CTMC model predicts two distinct outcomes, disease extinction or persistence, and demonstrates a positive probability of rabies extinction in finite time even when Re>1. This contrast is significant because the deterministic model predicts a certain outbreak under identical conditions, whereas the stochastic framework captures the possibility of early extinction due to demographic fluctuations. Sensitivity analysis identifies the natural death rate and culling intensity as the most influential parameters. Results show a direct correlation between culling intensity and the probability of rabies elimination.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of stray dog culling in rabies control by analyzing rabies dynamics within human and stray dog populations. The research addresses the need for understanding how demographic fluctuations influence rabies persistence or extinction.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A stochastic continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) model was used to simulate rabies dynamics in human and stray dog populations. The study was conducted through mathematical modeling, focusing on the disease-free equilibrium and stochastic threshold.
analysis.methods: The model employed a Galton-Watson branching process to derive the stochastic threshold, which was validated through 10,000 numerical sample paths. Sensitivity analysis was used to identify the most influential parameters affecting rabies dynamics.
analysis.main_results: The CTMC model predicts two distinct outcomes: disease extinction or persistence. It demonstrates that rabies can have a positive probability of extinction in finite time even when the deterministic reproduction number (Re) is greater than 1.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights that the deterministic model predicts a certain outbreak under identical conditions, while the stochastic framework captures the possibility of early extinction due to demographic fluctuations, offering a novel perspective on rabies control strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the role of demographic variability in rabies dynamics, which can inform more effective and context-sensitive public health strategies for rabies control.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on mathematical modeling and does not include empirical data, which may limit its generalizability. The evidence is moderate as it is based on theoretical simulations rather than real-world observations.

analysis.summary_en: This study uses a stochastic continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) model to investigate rabies dynamics within human and stray dog populations. The model explores the impact of demographic fluctuations on rabies persistence or extinction, contrasting deterministic predictions with stochastic outcomes. The research identifies the natural death rate and culling intensity as the most influential parameters through sensitivity analysis. It demonstrates that rabies can have a positive probability of extinction even when the reproduction number (Re) is greater than 1. The findings suggest that stochastic models may offer a more nuanced understanding of rabies control, particularly in scenarios involving population variability. However, the study's reliance on theoretical simulations limits its applicability to real-world settings. The results can inform public health strategies by emphasizing the importance of culling intensity and demographic factors in rabies eradication efforts.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过分析狂犬病在人类和流浪犬种群中的动态变化,评估流浪犬捕杀在狂犬病控制中的有效性。该研究探讨了如何理解人口波动对狂犬病持续存在或灭绝的影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 采用随机连续时间马尔可夫链(CTMC)模型来模拟狂犬病在人类和流浪犬种群中的动态变化。研究通过数学建模进行,重点分析了无病平衡状态和随机阈值。
elements_zh.methods: 该模型利用Galton-Watson分支过程推导出随机阈值,并通过10,000条数值样本路径进行验证。敏感性分析用于确定影响狂犬病动态变化的最关键参数。
elements_zh.main_results: CTMC模型预测了两种截然不同的结果:疾病灭绝或持续存在。它表明,即使当确定性再生数(Re)大于1时,狂犬病在有限时间内仍具有正的灭绝概率。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究指出,在相同条件下,确定性模型预测了暴发的确定性结果,而随机框架则捕捉了由于人口波动导致的早期灭绝可能性,为狂犬病控制策略提供了新的视角。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为理解人口变异性在狂犬病动态变化中的作用提供了见解,有助于制定更具针对性和情境适应性的狂犬病控制公共卫生策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究依赖数学建模,未包含实证数据,这可能限制其普遍适用性。由于证据基于理论模拟而非现实观察,因此其强度中等。

abstract_zh: 一个基于确定性方法的随机连续时间马尔可夫链(CTMC)模型,研究了狂犬病在人类和流浪犬种群中的动态变化。稳定性分析证实,当Re 1时,无病平衡状态是全局渐近稳定的。通过Galton-Watson分支过程,推导出随机阈值,其灭绝概率与10,000条数值样本路径高度一致。CTMC模型预测了两种截然不同的结果:疾病灭绝或持续存在,并表明即使当Re>1时,狂犬病在有限时间内仍具有正的灭绝概率。这种对比具有重要意义,因为在相同条件下,确定性模型预测了暴发的确定性结果,而随机框架则捕捉了由于种群波动导致的早期灭绝可能性。敏感性分析确定了自然死亡率和捕杀强度是最具影响力的参数。结果表明,捕杀强度与狂犬病消除概率之间存在直接关联。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过分析狂犬病在人类和流浪犬种群中的动态变化,评估流浪犬捕杀在狂犬病控制中的有效性。该研究探讨了如何理解人口波动对狂犬病持续存在或灭绝的影响。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 采用随机连续时间马尔可夫链(CTMC)模型来模拟狂犬病在人类和流浪犬种群中的动态变化。研究通过数学建模进行,重点分析了无病平衡状态和随机阈值。
analysis_zh.methods: 该模型利用Galton-Watson分支过程推导出随机阈值,并通过10,000条数值样本路径进行验证。敏感性分析用于确定影响狂犬病动态变化的最关键参数。
analysis_zh.main_results: CTMC模型预测了两种截然不同的结果:疾病灭绝或持续存在。它表明,即使当确定性再生数(Re)大于1时,狂犬病在有限时间内仍具有正的灭绝概率。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究指出,在相同条件下,确定性模型预测了暴发的确定性结果,而随机框架则捕捉了由于人口波动导致的早期灭绝可能性,为狂犬病控制策略提供了新的视角。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为理解人口变异性在狂犬病动态变化中的作用提供了见解,有助于制定更具针对性和情境适应性的狂犬病控制公共卫生策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究依赖数学建模,未包含实证数据,这可能限制其普遍适用性。由于证据基于理论模拟而非现实观察,因此其强度中等。

title: Retrospective evaluation of children immunized against rabies in a pediatric emergency department
abstract: Objective: Rabies is a fatal disease of the central nervous system. This study aimed to evaluate post-exposure rabies prophylaxis practices in a tertiary pediatric emergency department. Materials and Methods: In this retrospective observational study, the characteristics of patients aged 0-18 years who presented to the pediatric emergency due to a rabies-risk exposure and received rabies vaccination between March 1, 2023 and March 1, 2025 were examined. Patients whose first dose of rabies vaccine was administered at another center were excluded.Data were obtained by reviewing the hospital information management system and the rabies vaccination registry in which rabies vaccines were recorded. The patient’s demographic and clinical characteristics and data regarding risky exposures were recorded in the data collection form as study parameters. Results: A total of 2155 patients who received post-exposure prophylaxis were included in the study. The mean age of the patients was 105.7±60.7 months. Of the patients, 74.7% presented after contact with a cat and 24% after contact with a dog. The most common site of risky exposure was the upper extremity (56.8%), and the most common type of injury was scratching (69.7%). Head and neck injuries were significantly more frequent in exposures occurring at home (p<0.001) and differed significantly across age groups (p<0.001), decreasing with increasing age. Exposures most commonly involved animals that were stray (83.8%), unvaccinated (91.1%), and unobservable (83.2%). It was observed that 49.3% of patients completed the rabies vaccination schedule as recommended. Rabies immunoglobulin was administered to 12.7% of patients, local wound care to 6.9%, tetanus vaccine to 30.4%, antibiotics to 13.4%, and suturing was performed in 1.5%. Conclusion: Rabies-risk exposures most commonly occur with unowned stray animals. Injuries to high-risk regions such as the head and neck may be more common, particularly in young children and in exposures involving household animals.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 狂犬病是一种中枢神经系统致命性疾病。本研究旨在评估三级儿科急诊科中暴露后狂犬病的预防措施。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 材料和方法:本研究为回顾性观察性研究,分析了2023年3月1日至2025年3月1日期间因狂犬病风险暴露而前往儿科急诊科并接受了狂犬病 疫苗接种的0-18岁患者的特征。排除了在其他中心首次接种狂犬病 疫苗的患者。数据通过查阅医院信息系统和记录狂犬病 疫苗的狂犬病 疫苗接种登记册获得。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 共有2155名患者接受了暴露后预防。患者的平均年龄为105.7±60.7个月。其中74.7%的患者因接触猫而就诊,24%因接触狗而就诊。最常见的风险暴露部位是上肢(56.8%),最常见的损伤类型是抓伤(69.7%)。在家发生的暴露中,头部和颈部损伤显著更常见(p<0.001),且在不同年龄组中差异显著(p<0.001),随着年龄增长而减少。最常见的暴露动物是流浪动物(83.8%)、未接种疫苗的动物(91.1%)和难以观察的动物(83.2%)。观察到49.3%的患者按照推荐完成了狂犬病 疫苗接种接种计划。

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 狂犬病风险暴露最常见于无主流浪动物。头部和颈部等高风险区域的损伤可能更为常见,尤其是在幼儿和涉及家庭动物的暴露中。研究、监测、诊断、治疗、疫苗接种、生态学、风险评估或政策方面的具体优先事项包括了解导致疫苗接种接种计划不完整的因素,并改善暴露后预防实践。

analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 材料和方法:本研究为回顾性观察性研究,分析了2023年3月1日至2025年3月1日期间因狂犬病风险暴露而前往儿科急诊科并接受了狂犬病 疫苗接种的0-18岁患者的特征。排除了在其他中心首次接种狂犬病 疫苗的患者。数据通过查阅医院信息系统和记录狂犬病 疫苗的狂犬病 疫苗接种登记册获得。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 共有2155名患者接受了暴露后预防。患者的平均年龄为105.7±60.7个月。其中74.7%的患者因接触猫而就诊,24%因接触狗而就诊。最常见的风险暴露部位是上肢(56.8%),最常见的损伤类型是抓伤(69.7%)。在家发生的暴露中,头部和颈部损伤显著更常见(p<0.001),且在不同年龄组中差异显著(p<0.001),随着年龄增长而减少。最常见的暴露动物是流浪动物(83.8%)、未接种疫苗的动物(91.1%)和难以观察的动物(83.2%)。观察到49.3%的患者按照推荐完成了狂犬病 疫苗接种接种计划。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 提供的证据未报告异质性、矛盾发现、方法薄弱、缺失人群或地区,或未解决的机制。然而,本研究排除了在其他中心首次接种狂犬病 疫苗的患者,这可能引入选择偏倚。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 狂犬病风险暴露最常见于无主流浪动物。头部和颈部等高风险区域的损伤可能更为常见,尤其是在幼儿和涉及家庭动物的暴露中。研究、监测、诊断、治疗、疫苗接种、生态学、风险评估或政策方面的具体优先事项包括了解导致疫苗接种接种计划不完整的因素,并改善暴露后预防实践。

title: Circumstances preceding animal-bite exposures in a tertiary anti-rabies clinic in North India: a retrospective descriptive record review
abstract: Background Animal-bite-mediated rabies remains an important public health concern in India, where most human rabies cases are associated with dog bites. Prevention strategies commonly emphasize avoiding risky human–animal interactions; however, little is known about the circumstances and activities immediately preceding animal bite exposures among individuals presenting for postexposure care. Understanding these documented exposure contexts may help refine prevention strategies. Objective To characterize the behavioral and environmental circumstances preceding animal bite exposures in a rabies-endemic North Indian tertiary care setting and explore an activity-based classification of documented exposure contexts. Methods We conducted a retrospective descriptive review of 235 animal-bite records from a tertiary anti-rabies clinic in North India. Clinical records were reviewed to identify documented circumstances preceding the bite, activity at the time of exposure, human–animal interaction context, first-aid practices, and postexposure care-related information. Exposure contexts were derived inductively from record descriptions and descriptively grouped into categories reflecting passive environmental exposure, intentional human–animal interaction, and accidental disturbance. The classification was adapted conceptually from exposure-context approaches used in other zoonotic disease epidemiology, with modifications to account for defensive animal biting. Results Among 235 bite-event records screened, 233 animal-bite records were included in the exposure-context analysis. Most patients presented with WHO Category III exposures (165/235, 70.2%), followed by Category II exposures (70/235, 29.8%). Incidental exposure during routine activity was the most frequently documented circumstance, accounting for 149/233 cases (63.9%), including transient exposure during movement (116/233, 49.8%) and stationary exposure during sitting or standing (33/233, 14.2%). Intentional human–animal interaction accounted for 77/233 cases (33.0%), comprising caregiving-related interactions (40/233, 17.2%) and play-related interactions (37/233, 15.9%). Exposure following accidental disturbance was documented in 7/233 cases (3.0%). Conclusion In this clinic-based sample, most documented animal-bite exposures occurred during routine activities without recorded intentional interaction with animals, followed by intentional human–animal contact and accidental disturbance. These findings describe exposure circumstances among patients seeking post-exposure care but should not be interpreted as estimates of activity-specific bite risk or community incidence because population exposure denominators were unavailable.

title: Mathematical Model of Canine Rabies Transmission Dynamics with Combined Pre and Post Exposure Vaccination
abstract: Canine rabies remains an important public health concern, and mathematical modeling provides a useful framework for understanding its transmission dynamics and evaluating vaccination strategies. This study develops a deterministic mathematical model for canine rabies transmission incorporating pre- and post-exposure vaccination. The positivity and boundedness of the model solutions are established, the rabies-free equilibrium is determined, and the effective reproduction number is derived. The rabies-free equilibrium is shown to be locally asymptotically stable whenever and unstable whenever The condition for the existence of an endemic equilibrium is established, and sensitivity analysis indicates that increases with the transmission contact rate , whereas increasing the disease-induced death rate reduces Numerical simulations are conducted to examine the effects of pre- and post-exposure vaccine effectiveness on rabies transmission dynamics. The results show that increasing the effectiveness of both vaccination strategies reduces rabies transmission and increases the number of protected dogs. However, pre-exposure vaccination has a greater effect on the protected dog population than post-exposure vaccination.

title_zh: 犬类狂犬病与联合暴露前和暴露后疫苗接种策略的动态数学模型
source_body_en: Canine rabies remains an important public health concern, and mathematical modeling provides a useful framework for understanding its transmission dynamics and evaluating vaccination strategies. This study develops a deterministic mathematical model for canine rabies transmission incorporating pre- and post-exposure vaccination. The positivity and boundedness of the model solutions are established, the rabies-free equilibrium is determined, and the effective reproduction number is derived. The rabies-free equilibrium is shown to be locally asymptotically stable whenever and unstable whenever The condition for the existence of an endemic equilibrium is established, and sensitivity analysis indicates that increases with the transmission contact rate , whereas increasing the disease-induced death rate reduces Numerical simulations are conducted to examine the effects of pre- and post-exposure vaccine effectiveness on rabies transmission dynamics. The results show that increasing the effectiveness of both vaccination strategies reduces rabies transmission and increases the number of protected dogs. However, pre-exposure vaccination has a greater effect on the protected dog population than post-exposure vaccination.
abstract_zh: 犬类狂犬病仍然是重要的公共卫生问题,数学建模为理解其传播动态和评估疫苗接种策略提供了一个有用的框架。本研究开发了一个确定性的数学模型,用于模拟犬类狂犬病 传播动态,结合了暴露前和暴露后疫苗接种策略。模型解的正性和有界性得到了确立,狂犬病无病平衡点被确定,有效再生数也被推导出来。研究显示,当满足一定条件时,狂犬病无病平衡点是局部渐近稳定的,而在其他情况下则不稳定。建立了流行病学平衡点存在的条件,并通过敏感性分析表明,传播接触率的增加会导致的上升,而疾病导致的死亡率的增加则会降低。进行了数值模拟以研究暴露前和暴露后疫苗策略的有效性对狂犬病 传播动态的影响。结果表明,提高两种疫苗接种策略的有效性会减少狂犬病 传播并增加受保护犬的数量。然而,暴露前疫苗接种对受保护犬群的影响比暴露后疫苗接种更大。

title: Pendekatan Komunitas untuk Pencegahan Rabies di Bali: Sebuah Narrative Review
abstract: Background: Rabies was introduced to Bali in November 2008 and continues to cause human deaths despite repeated mass dog vaccination. In 2025, 16 deaths were recorded, almost all among bite victims who were not brought to a health facility, indicating that the main barriers to control now lie largely in community behaviour and participation. Objective: To examine the evidence on the forms, roles, achievements, and challenges of community-based approaches to rabies prevention in Bali. Methods: A narrative review of scientific articles, programme reports, and policy documents published in 2008–2026, identified through PubMed, Google Scholar, DOAJ, Garuda, SINTA, and official government portals, and synthesised thematically with reference to the SANRA criteria. Results: Community contributions were identified in five domains: (1) the socio-cultural capital of banjar and customary villages (desa adat) as vehicles for mobilisation; (2) strengthening knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) on responsible dog ownership and bite-wound management; (3) community-based intervention models, such as Program Dharma in Sanur, which reduced the proportion of dogs with welfare problems from 20.7% to 2.7%; (4) customary regulation through pararem; and (5) community involvement in surveillance and integrated bite case management, Rabies Alert Teams (Tisira), and digital applications. Key challenges include low vaccination coverage of puppies and free-roaming dogs, delayed care-seeking, funding sustainability, and programme fatigue in the elimination end-game. Conclusion: Community approaches are an essential complement to mass dog vaccination and post-exposure prophylaxis. Institutionalising the role of customary villages within a One Health framework, supported by indicator-based monitoring, is needed to achieve a rabies-free Bali by 2030.
journal: Journal of Innovation Research and Knowledge

abstract_original: Background: Rabies was introduced to Bali in November 2008 and continues to cause human deaths despite repeated mass dog vaccination. In 2025, 16 deaths were recorded, almost all among bite victims who were not brought to a health facility, indicating that the main barriers to control now lie largely in community behaviour and participation. Objective: To examine the evidence on the forms, roles, achievements, and challenges of community-based approaches to rabies prevention in Bali. Methods: A narrative review of scientific articles, programme reports, and policy documents published in 2008–2026, identified through PubMed, Google Scholar, DOAJ, Garuda, SINTA, and official government portals, and synthesised thematically with reference to the SANRA criteria. Results: Community contributions were identified in five domains: (1) the socio-cultural capital of banjar and customary villages (desa adat) as vehicles for mobilisation; (2) strengthening knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) on responsible dog ownership and bite-wound management; (3) community-based intervention models, such as Program Dharma in Sanur, which reduced the proportion of dogs with welfare problems from 20.7% to 2.7%; (4) customary regulation through pararem; and (5) community involvement in surveillance and integrated bite case management, Rabies Alert Teams (Tisira), and digital applications. Key challenges include low vaccination coverage of puppies and free-roaming dogs, delayed care-seeking, funding sustainability, and programme fatigue in the elimination end-game. Conclusion: Community approaches are an essential complement to mass dog vaccination and post-exposure prophylaxis. Institutionalising the role of customary villages within a One Health framework, supported by indicator-based monitoring, is needed to achieve a rabies-free Bali by 2030.

abstract_zh: 背景:狂犬病于2008年11月被引入巴厘岛,并且尽管反复进行大规模犬只疫苗接种接种,仍持续导致人类死亡。2025年记录了16例死亡,几乎所有死亡病例都发生在未被送往医疗机构的咬伤受害者中,这表明目前控制该疾病的主要障碍主要在于社区行为和参与度。目的:评估巴厘岛社区基于方法在预防狂犬病方面的形式、作用、成就和挑战。方法:对2008年至2026年间发表的科学文章、项目报告和政策文件进行叙述性综述,这些资料通过PubMed、Google Scholar、DOAJ、Garuda、SINTA和政府官方网站识别,并根据SANRA标准进行主题综合。结果:社区贡献被划分为五个领域:(1)通过banjar和传统村落(desa adat)的社会文化资本作为动员工具;(2)加强负责任犬只饲养和伤口处理的知识、态度和行为(KAP);(3)社区为基础的干预模式,如Sanur的Program Dharma,将有福利问题的犬只比例从20.7%降至2.7%;(4)通过pararem进行的传统规范管理;(5)社区参与监测和综合咬伤病例管理,狂犬病警报小组(Tisira)以及数字应用程序。主要挑战包括对幼犬和流浪犬的疫苗接种覆盖率低、延迟寻求医疗帮助、资金可持续性以及消除阶段的项目疲劳。结论:社区方法是大规模犬只疫苗接种和暴露后预防的重要补充。为了在2030年前实现巴厘岛无狂犬病,需要在“一人健康”框架内制度化传统村落的作用,并通过基于指标的监测加以支持。

title: The animal is not only a reservoir: rabies and the limits of one health
abstract: Rabies demonstrates both the value and the limitations of the One Health approach as a public-health framework. Although mass dog vaccination and timely post-exposure prophylaxis can prevent human deaths, surveillance frequently underestimates disease burden, while control programs may treat dogs primarily as reservoirs or population denominators. Drawing together natural science, history, and anthropology, and narrating a remembered encounter with a rabid community dog named Lucky, this commentary examines what that framing overlooks. Epidemiology identifies transmission pathways and surveillance gaps; history reveals how ownership and administrative categories allocate responsibility; and anthropology shows how care, fear, and contested belonging influence reporting and cooperation. We argue that effective rabies control requires more than vaccination targets. Success should include zero human deaths, reduced canine rabies, equitable access to post-exposure prophylaxis, stronger surveillance, humane animal management, and public trust.

It argues that rabies is not only a zoonotic disease but also a complex issue involving social, historical, and ecological dimensions. The study highlights the need for a more holistic strategy that includes zero human deaths, reduced canine rabies, equitable access to post-exposure prophylaxis, stronger surveillance, humane animal management, and public trust. The authors suggest that effective rabies control requires more than just vaccination targets, as it involves understanding the social and historical contexts that influence disease reporting and cooperation. The evidence is based on a narrative review that integrates natural science, history, and anthropology, but it does not provide specific study design or results. The findings are interpreted as a call for a more comprehensive approach to rabies control, which includes addressing the social and historical factors that affect public health outcomes.

title: Visualization and Morphological Analysis of Individual Oligodendrocytes in the Mouse White Matter.
abstract: Myelin formation by oligodendrocytes is essential for the regulation of the conduction velocity and proper brain function. To ensure accurate information processing in response to experiences such as sensory stimuli and learning, oligodendrocytes adjust their number and morphology. In addition, oligodendrocyte morphology changes with senescence and in the presence of neurodegenerative diseases. Thus, visualizing oligodendrocytes and analyzing their morphology is crucial for understanding how our brains change under such conditions. Herein, we describe the methods for labeling and analyzing the morphologies of individual oligodendrocytes in mouse white matter at the light microscopic level. PDGFRa-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP and PLP-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP mice enable us to visualize and analyze later-born or early-born oligodendrocyte morphology. In addition, sparse oligodendrocyte labeling with attenuated rabies virus expressing GFP enables the visualization and morphological analysis of individual oligodendrocytes in various brain white matter regions without the need for transgenic animals. Furthermore, the combination with immunostaining in thick tissues enables the identification of labeled oligodendrocytes and myelin sheaths, as well as their interactions with neuronal axons. These methods are suitable for revealing how oligodendrocytes adapt their morphologies depending on environmental stimuli or pathological conditions.

title_zh: 小鼠白质中单个少突胶质细胞的可视化与形态学分析
source_body_en: Myelin formation by oligodendrocytes is essential for the regulation of the conduction velocity and proper brain function. To ensure accurate information processing in response to experiences such as sensory stimuli and learning, oligodendrocytes adjust their number and morphology. abstract_zh: 少突胶质细胞形成髓鞘对于调节传导速度和维持正常脑功能至关重要。为了确保对如感觉刺激和学习等经验的准确信息处理,少突胶质细胞会调整其数量和形态。此外,少突胶质细胞的形态也会随着衰老和神经退行性疾病的发生而发生变化。因此,对少突胶质细胞进行可视化和形态学分析对于理解我们的大脑在这些条件下的变化至关重要。本文描述了在光学显微镜水平上对小鼠白质中单个少突胶质细胞进行标记和形态学分析的方法。PDGFRa-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP和PLP-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP小鼠使我们能够可视化和分析晚期出生或早期出生的少突胶质细胞的形态。此外,使用减弱的狂犬病病毒表达GFP的稀疏少突胶质细胞标记方法,可以在无需转基因动物的情况下,对各种脑白质区域中的单个少突胶质细胞进行可视化和形态学分析。此外,与厚组织免疫染色相结合,可以识别标记的少突胶质细胞和髓鞘,以及它们与神经元轴突的相互作用。这些方法适用于揭示少突胶质细胞如何根据环境刺激或病理条件调整其形态。

title: Choix et Observance d’Un Schéma Intradermique Gratuit de Prophylaxie Post-Exposition Antirabique à Bouaké, Côte d’Ivoire Choice and Adherence to a Free Intradermal Rabies Post-Exposure Prophylaxis Regimen in Bouaké, Côte d’Ivoire
abstract: RÉSUMÉContexte et objectif. La prophylaxie post-exposition (PPE) prévient la rage humaine lorsqu'elle est instaurée rapidement et menée à son terme. Cette étude visait à décrire le choix d'un schéma intradermique gratuit à Bouaké, les facteurs associés à ce choix et son association avec l'achèvement de la PPE. Notre étude observationnelle descriptive et analytique a été menée de janvier à décembre 2020 à l'Institut national d'hygiène publique de Bouaké, en Côte d'Ivoire, auprès de 604 personnes exposées au risque rabique. Les caractéristiques sociodémographiques, les connaissances, les pratiques après exposition, l'information reçue, le choix du schéma et le statut de la PPE ont été étudiés. Les associations ont été recherchées par le chi-deux de Pearson au seuil de 5 %. Parmi les 604 participants, 463 (76,7 %) ont choisi le schéma intradermique gratuit. Ce choix était plus fréquent chez les résidents urbains que ruraux (79,9 % contre 60,8 % ; p < 0,001) et variait selon l'information reçue sur le traitement (p = 0,003). Parmi les 434 participants dont l'issue était connue, l'achèvement était plus fréquent avec le schéma gratuit qu'avec un autre schéma (77,1 % contre 52,8 % ; p < 0,001). Le schéma intradermique gratuit a été choisi par plus des trois quarts des personnes exposées. Son choix était associé à une proportion plus élevée d'achèvement parmi les dossiers dont l'issue était connue. Ces résultats soutiennent la réduction des barrières financières et le renforcement de l'information et du suivi.ABSTRACTBackground and objective. Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) prevents human rabies when initiated promptly and completed. This study aimed to describe the choice of a free intradermal regimen in Bouaké, factors associated with this choice, and its association with PEP completion. An observational descriptive and analytical study was conducted from January to December 2020 at the National Institute of Public Hygiene in Bouaké, Côte d'Ivoire, among 604 persons exposed to rabies risk. Sociodemographic characteristics, knowledge, post-exposure practices, information received, regimen choice, and PEP status were studied. Associations were sought using Pearson's chi-squared test at the 5% threshold. Among 604 participants, 463 (76.7%) chose the free intradermal regimen. This choice was more frequent among urban than rural residents (79.9% vs 60.8%; p < 0.001) and varied with information received about treatment (p = 0.003). Among 434 participants with known outcome, completion was more frequent with the free regimen than with another regimen (77.1% vs 52.8%; p < 0.001). The free intradermal regimen was chosen by more than three-quarters of exposed persons. Its choice was associated with a higher proportion of completion among cases with known outcome. These findings support reducing financial barriers and strengthening information and follow-up.

It found that 76.7% of participants opted for the free regimen, with urban residents more likely to choose it than rural ones. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述在布亚凯选择免费的皮内给药方案的情况,与该选择相关的因素,以及其与暴露后预防(PEP)完成率之间的关联。背景指出,当及时开始并完成暴露后预防(PEP)时,可以预防人类狂犬病。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项观察性描述性和分析性研究于2020年1月至12月在科特迪瓦布阿凯的国家公共卫生研究所中开展,研究对象为604名暴露于狂犬病风险的人。在604名参与者中,463人(76.7%)选择了免费的皮内给药方案。在434名具有已知结局的参与者中,采用免费方案的完成率高于另一种方案(77.1% vs 52.8%;p < 0.001)。
elements_zh.methods: 社会人口学特征、知识、暴露后行为、接收到的信息、治疗方案选择以及暴露后预防(PEP)状态进行了研究。采用皮尔逊卡方检验在5%显著性水平下探讨相关性。
elements_zh.main_results: 这一选择在城市居民中比农村居民更为常见(79.9% vs 60.8%;p < 0.001),且与接收到的关于治疗的信息有关(p = 0.003)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 选择免费的皮内接种方案与已知结局病例中较高的完成比例相关。这些发现支持减少经济障碍并加强信息和随访。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果表明,提供免费的皮内给药方案可以提高暴露后预防在狂犬病暴露个体中的依从性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究为观察性和描述性研究,这可能限制因果推断。证据为中等,因为它依赖于自我报告数据和统计关联,而非实验性控制。

title: Approaches to the prevention and post-exposure treatment of rabies
abstract: Rabies is an acute viral encephalomyelitis that is almost always fatal once symptoms appear, although vaccination and early treatment can be effective if administrated after exposure and before clinical rabies develops. Health professionals in primary care are responsible for providing travellers with advice on risk, prevention, pre-exposure vaccination and post-exposure treatment. This article will examine the disease, and the factors that may put travellers at greater risk, and provides practical guidance on vaccination schedules and management. It is concluded that accurate travel health advice is essential to help travellers understand the risks and take appropriate preventive and post-exposure measures.

title_zh: 预防和暴露后治疗的策略
source_body_en: Rabies is an acute viral encephalomyelitis that is almost always fatal once symptoms appear, although vaccination and early treatment can be effective if administrated after exposure and before clinical rabies develops. Health professionals in primary care are responsible for providing travellers with advice on risk, prevention, pre-exposure vaccination and post-exposure treatment. This article will examine the disease, and the factors that may put travellers at greater risk, and provides practical guidance on vaccination schedules and management. It is concluded that accurate travel health advice is essential to help travellers understand the risks and take appropriate preventive and post-exposure measures.

title: A qualitative exploration of perceptions, practices, and systemic barriers to rabies post-exposure prophylaxis in a rural area of Uttarakhand, India
abstract: Rabies continues to be a universally fatal yet preventable neglected tropical disease (NTD). While most studies on animal bites are quantitative and describe the burden of exposure, there is limited literature capturing the socio-cultural, behavioural and systemic factors that shape response and health-seeking behaviour following an animal bite, particularly in rural settings. To explore perceptions, practices, and barriers related to rabies prevention and its post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) among individuals with animal bite/s. A qualitative descriptive-exploratory study was conducted among 21 individuals who had presented with animal bites at a rural health facility in Uttarakhand, India. Participants were purposively sampled from a record-derived line listing to ensure variation in exposure category, health-seeking behaviour and PEP completion. Semi-structured interviews (16 face-to-face, five telephonic) were conducted in Hindi until data saturation was reached. Data were analysed using Braun and Clarke’s six-phase reflexive thematic analysis, and the resulting themes were subsequently mapped onto the Health Belief Model and the Socio-Ecological Model. Five themes were identified: perceived invulnerability and normalization of animal bites; misconceptions and fragmented knowledge about rabies; culturally embedded and inadequate wound care practices; structural and cognitive barriers to completion of PEP; and dependence on informal health information networks. Non-completion of PEP was driven less by absence of information than by locally coherent risk judgements, culturally sanctioned wound-care practices that displaced evidence-based first aid, and the unavailability of rabies immunoglobulin at the point of first contact. Prevention of rabies in this study setting was shaped by interconnected cultural, behavioural and systemic factors operating simultaneously at individual, interpersonal, community and health-system levels; because these determinants sustain one another, interventions addressing any single level are unlikely to improve adherence to the recommended PEP schedule in similar rural contexts.

source_records.abstract: Abstract Background Rabies continues to be a universally fatal yet preventable neglected tropical disease (NTD). While most studies conducted on animal bites are predominantly quantitative describing the burden of animal bites, there is limited literature that captures the socio-cultural, behavioural and systemic factors that affect response and health-seeking behaviour following exposure to animal bites and its prophylaxis especially in rural settings. Aim To explore perceptions, practices, and barriers related to Rabies prevention and its post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) among animal bite victims. Methods A qualitative exploratory study was conducted among individuals who presented with animal bites at a rural health facility in the state of Uttarakhand, India. Purposive sampling was done in order to ascertain variations in severity of exposure, healthcare-seeking behaviour, and PEP compliance and adherence. Semi-structured interviews were conducted telephonically to collect data. Data was then analysed using Braun and Clarke’s six-phase reflexive thematic analysis. Results Five overarching themes were identified: 1. Perceived invulnerability and normalization of animal bites, 2. Misconceptions and fragmented knowledge about Rabies, 3. Culturally embedded and inadequate wound care practices, 4. Structural and cognitive barriers to completion of PEP and 5.Informal health networks. Conclusion It was concluded that prevention of Rabies especially in rural settings is influenced to a great extent by complex interconnected cultural, behavioural and systemic factors. Many myths, traditional socio-cultural practices, economic constraints and infrastructural and logistic related barriers to healthcare collectively undermine the adherence to the recommended PEP schedule.

title_zh: 对印度乌塔拉坎德邦农村地区关于狂犬病 暴露后预防 的认知、实践和系统性障碍的定性探索
source_body_en: Rabies continues to be a universally fatal yet preventable neglected tropical disease (NTD). While most studies on animal bites are quantitative and describe the burden of exposure, there is limited literature capturing the socio-cultural, behavioural and systemic factors that shape response and health-seeking behaviour following an animal bite, particularly in rural settings. To explore perceptions, practices, and barriers related to rabies prevention and its post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) among individuals with animal bite/s. A qualitative descriptive-exploratory study was conducted among 21 individuals who had presented with animal bites at a rural health facility in Uttarakhand, India. Participants were purposively sampled from a record-derived line listing to ensure variation in exposure category, health-seeking behaviour and PEP completion. Semi-structured interviews (16 face-to-face, five telephonic) were conducted in Hindi until data saturation was reached. Data were analysed using Braun and Clarke’s six-phase reflexive thematic analysis, and the resulting themes were subsequently mapped onto the Health Belief Model and the Socio-Ecological Model. Five themes were identified: perceived invulnerability and normalization of animal bites; misconceptions and fragmented knowledge about rabies; culturally embedded and inadequate wound care practices; structural and cognitive barriers to completion of PEP; and dependence on informal health information networks. Non-completion of PEP was driven less by absence of information than by locally coherent risk judgements, culturally sanctioned wound-care practices that displaced evidence-based first aid, and the unavailability of rabies immunoglobulin at the point of first contact. Prevention of rabies in this study setting was shaped by interconnected cultural, behavioural and systemic factors operating simultaneously at individual, interpersonal, community and health-system levels; because these determinants sustain one another, interventions addressing any single level are unlikely to improve adherence to the recommended PEP schedule in similar rural contexts.

title: Safety, Immunogenicity, Antibody Persistence, and Booster Responses of an Animal-Component-Free Vero Cell Rabies Vaccine: A Randomized, Active-Controlled Phase III
abstract: Abstract Background Eliminating animal-source additives from vaccine manufacture may reduce dependence on variable biological raw materials and the theoretical risk of adventitious-agent or extraneous-protein contamination. This study aimed to assess the safety and immunogenicity of an animal-component-free, antibiotic-free, freeze-dried human rabies vaccine (Vero Cell) with the "Essen" regimen and boosted two doses in China. Methods 1,200 healthy participants aged 10–60 years were randomized into two groups to receive the test vaccine or a licensed freeze-dried human Rabies Vaccine (Vero Cell) with the five doses Essen regimen. Two prespecified test-vaccine subcohorts received two booster doses with 3 days interval at month 3 or month 12 after primary Essen regimen respectively. Blood samples for immunogenicity assessment were collected pre-vaccination, on day 7 and 14 following the first dose, and day 14 and months 3, 6, and 12 following the final dose of the primary regimen. Additionally, samples were obtained before (months 3 or 12 respectively) and after two doses booster regimen. Rabies virus-neutralizing antibody (RVNA) concentrations were measured by the rapid fluorescent focus inhibition test (RFFIT). Safety observation was conducted during 30 days after each vaccination. Serious adverse event (SAE) was conducted throughout all the observation period. Results Out of 1,200 randomized participants, 596 in the test group and 600 in the control group included in the final safety analysis (SS). The test vaccine induced a significantly higher early seroconversion rate and geometric mean concentration (GMC) at Day 7 post-first dose. By Day 14 post-first dose and post-primary series, both groups achieved 100% seroconversion and comparable peak GMCs, with non-inferiority of the two groups. Over the 12-month persistence period, seroconversion rates remained high to 98% in both groups, with GMCs declining in parallel. Following a two-dose booster, both test-vaccine subgroups achieved 100% seropositivity by Day 14 post-booster. The reported adverse reactions (ARs) were primarily mild. No vaccine-related SAEs reported throughout the whole study period. Overall, the test vaccine demonstrated comparable immunogenicity, sustained antibody persistence, and a similar safety profile to the control vaccine. Conclusion The animal-component-free test human rabies vaccine (Vero Cell) induced non-inferior immunogenicity to the licensed vaccine following the primary Essen regimen, maintained RVNA responses at least one year, elicited robust responses to two-dose boosting even after a prolonged interval to 12 months. It exhibited a acceptable safety profile all through the whole period. These pivotal data establish the clinical performance of a manufacturing platform that avoids animal-source additives. Trial Registration Prior to enrollment, the trial was registered with the Drug Clinical Trial Registration and Information Disclosure Platform in China on December 6, 2021(Registration No.: CXSL2010236). At the time of study initiation, registration in an ICMJE-approved registry was not required by regulators in China, and the investigators were unaware of the ICMJE requirement. After completion of participant enrollment and before data analysis, the trial was registered with the Chinese Clinical Trial Registry on September 24, 2024 (Registration No.: ChiCTR2400089683). Before preparation of this manuscript, the trial was retrospectively registered with ClinicalTrials.gov in June 23, 2026 (NCT07672626). No changes were made to the primary outcome, eligibility criteria, or statistical analysis plan throughout these registration processes. We acknowledge that retrospective registration deviates from the ICMJE requirement for prospective registration and consider this a limitation of our study.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估一种不含动物成分、不含抗生素、冻干的人用疫苗 狂犬病(Vero细胞)疫苗在中国采用"Essen"方案并加强两剂后的安全性及免疫原性。背景指出,从疫苗生产中去除动物源性添加剂可能会减少对可变生物原材料的依赖,并降低外源性污染或异源蛋白污染的理论风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项随机、活性对照的III期研究在1200名年龄在10至60岁之间的健康受试者中进行。受试者被随机分配至两组,分别接受测试药物疫苗或已获批的冻干人用狂犬病 疫苗(Vero细胞)疫苗,采用五剂Essen方案。
elements_zh.methods: 通过快速荧光聚焦抑制试验(RFFIT)测量狂犬病病毒中和抗体(RVNA)浓度。用于免疫原性评估的血液样本在疫苗接种前、首次剂量后的第7天和第14天、以及主要方案的最终剂量后的第14天和第3、6和12个月收集。
elements_zh.main_results: 在1200名随机分配的受试者中,最终安全性分析(SS)纳入了596名测试组和600名对照组受试者。测试疫苗在首次剂量后第7天诱导了显著更高的早期血清转化率和几何平均浓度(GMC)。在首次剂量后第14天以及完成基础系列接种后,两组均达到了100%的血清转化率,并且峰值GMC相当,两组之间具有非劣效性。在12个月的持续期中,两组的血清转化率均保持在98%的高水平,且GMC呈平行下降趋势。在接种两剂加强针后,测试-疫苗两个亚组在加强针后第14天均达到了100%的血清阳性率。报告的不良反应(ARs)主要为轻度。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Rabies Outbreak Surveillance and Prediction: A Systematic Review of Recent Advances, Challenges, and Future Directions
abstract: Rabies poses a major threat to human and animal health, but outbreak prediction remains challenging because surveillance data are uneven and transmission patterns are complex. Recently, various artificial intelligence (AI) solutions have emerged to support rabies surveillance, prediction, and outbreak control. Therefore, this study presents a systematic review of rabies surveillance and prediction, aiming to identify recent advances, research gaps, and future directions. Specifically, this review examined current state-of-the-art modelling approaches, data sources, predictive factors, and evaluation practices. PubMed, Public Health Database (ProQuest), Scopus, Web of Science and IEEE Xplore were searched for studies published between January 2015 and September 2026. An adapted PROBAST+AI assessment was used to examine reporting and evaluation practices. A total of 36 studies were shortlisted, with machine learning being the most widely used approach, especially for classification and spatial prediction, reflecting its capture complex relationships among predictive factors. Statistical models remained competitive for seasonal forecasting but less flexible in capturing non-linear relationships, while hybrid approaches combined complementary techniques at the cost of greater model complexity. Moreover, government surveillance records and open-access databases were the main data sources. Several gaps remain, including uneven data quality and accessibility, incomplete integration of predictive factors, class imbalance, and limited explainability. Future research should improve data standardization, assess the value of integrating multi-source data, address class imbalance, strengthen model validation and interpretability, and adopt a standardized model-development pipeline. These recommendations are believed to serve as guidelines for promoting future rabies prediction research.

abstract_zh: 狂犬病对人类和动物健康构成重大威胁,但暴发预测仍面临挑战,因为监测数据分布不均且传播模式复杂。近年来,各种人工智能(AI)解决方案已出现,以支持狂犬病 监测、预测和暴发控制。因此,本研究系统综述了狂犬病 监测和预测,旨在识别近期进展、研究空白和未来方向。具体而言,本综述考察了当前最先进的建模方法、数据来源、预测因素和评估实践。在PubMed、公共卫生数据库(ProQuest)、Scopus、Web of Science和IEEE Xplore中搜索了2015年1月至2026年9月期间发表的研究。采用改编的PROBAST+AI评估方法来考察报告和评估实践。共筛选出36项研究,其中机器学习是最广泛使用的方法,尤其是在分类和空间预测方面,反映了其在捕捉预测因素复杂关系方面的优势。统计模型在季节性预测中仍具有竞争力,但在捕捉非线性关系方面不够灵活,而混合方法结合了互补技术,但以更大的模型复杂性为代价。此外,政府监测记录和开放获取数据库是主要的数据来源。仍存在一些空白,包括数据质量和可访问性的不均衡、预测因素整合不完整、类别不平衡以及解释性有限。未来的研究应改进数据标准化,评估多源数据整合的价值,解决类别不平衡问题,加强模型验证和可解释性,并采用标准化的模型开发流程。这些建议被认为可以作为促进未来狂犬病预测研究的指导方针。

title: First detection of canine distemper virus infection in varie¬gated squirrels (Sciurus variegatoides) and porcupines (Coendou mexicanus) in Costa Rica
abstract: Canine distemper virus (CDV) is a multi-host pathogen capable of infecting a wide range of do-mestic and wild mammals, however, reports of infection in squirrels and porcupines remain scarce. As part of the wildlife rabies surveillance programme in Costa Rica, six wild mammals (four Sciurus variegatoides and two Coendou mexicanus) with neurological signs were evaluated to rule out rabies. All brain samples tested negative for rabies by direct immunofluorescence and RT-PCR. Rapid distemper antigen tests of ocular and nasal secretions were positive in both porcupines, which were subsequently euthanised. Advanced autolysis prevented histopathological evaluation in five of the animals; however, one squirrel showed severe neutrophilic pneumonia with necrosis and haemorrhage, a moderate lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate in the pulmonary interstitium, intracytoplasmic inclusion bodies in bronchial epithelium, and a focal neutrophilic infiltrate in the midbrain. The findings were consistent with CDV infection accompanied by severe systemic bacterial infection. CDV was confirmed in two of the four squirrels and in the two porcupines by RT-PCR and sequencing. Phylogenetic analysis revealed that the Costa Rican sequences grouped into two distinct clusters: one containing both squirrels and another with both porcupines. All four sequences shared a common ancestor with CDV strains detected in domestic dogs in the United States (2012–2013), and more distantly with a dog strain from Argentina (2005). These cases represent one of the few documented occurrences of CDV in squirrels and porcupines worldwide and the first reported in Costa Rica, underscoring the need for continued molecular surveillance to clarify lineage dynamics and spillover pathways.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports the first detection of canine distemper virus (CDV) in variegated squirrels and porcupines in Costa Rica. Six wild mammals with neurological signs were evaluated as part of a rabies surveillance program. Brain samples tested negative for rabies, but rapid distemper antigen tests were positive in both porcupines. One squirrel showed histopathological signs consistent with CDV infection. CDV was confirmed in two squirrels and both porcupines using RT-PCR and sequencing. Phylogenetic analysis revealed distinct clusters for the Costa Rican sequences. These findings emphasize the need for molecular surveillance to understand CDV dynamics and spillover in wildlife. The study provides moderate confidence due to the limited number of animals analyzed and the presence of advanced autolysis in most specimens.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 犬瘟热病毒(CDV)是一种多宿主病原体,能够感染多种家养和野生动物,然而,关于其在松鼠和豪猪中的感染报告仍然很少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 作为哥斯达黎加野生动物监测项目的一部分,对六只表现出神经系统症状的野生哺乳动物(四只Sciurus variegatoides和两只Coendou mexicanus)进行了评估以排除某种病原体。
elements_zh.methods: 所有脑组织样本通过直接免疫荧光和RT-PCR检测均未发现该病原体。通过RT-PCR和测序确认了其中两只松鼠和两只豪猪感染了CDV。
elements_zh.main_results: 对豪猪的结膜液和鼻分泌物进行的快速犬瘟热抗原检测呈阳性,随后这些豪猪被安乐死。五只动物因严重的自溶作用而无法进行组织病理学评估;然而,一只松鼠表现出严重的中性粒细胞性肺炎伴有坏死和出血,肺间质中有中度的淋巴浆细胞浸润,支气管上皮细胞中有胞浆内包涵体,中脑区域有局灶性中性粒细胞性浸润。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现与CDV感染伴随严重的系统性细菌感染一致。这些病例是全球少数记录的CDV在松鼠和豪猪中的感染案例之一,也是哥斯达黎加首次报告,强调了继续进行分子监测以明确病毒谱系动态和传播途径的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现突显了分子监测在理解CDV谱系动态和传播途径中的重要性,这可以为疾病预防和控制的公共卫生策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告研究的局限性,但这些发现得到了一种动物的分子确认和组织病理学分析的支持,表明结果具有中等程度的可信度。

title: Wound-Only versus Weight-Based Rabies Immunoglobulin in Post-Exposure Prophylaxis: A Quasi-Randomized Asessor Blind Non-Inferiority Trial
abstract: Rabies is a fatal but preventable zoonotic disease that causes more than 20,000 deaths annually in India. Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) involves rabies vaccination and passive immunization with rabies immunoglobulin (RIG). Traditional RIG dosing is based on patient weight, whereas wound-only administration targets local viral neutralization at the exposure site. In the present study, antibody responses were compared after a three-dose anti-rabies vaccination in patients receiving either wound-only or weight-based RIG infiltration as part of PEP to assess the noninferiority of the wound-only approach. Patients with category III rabies exposure were enrolled in this noninferiority clinical trial, all of whom received a standard three-dose rabies vaccination. Rabies immunoglobulin was administered either according to body weight or infiltrated only around the wound. Serum rabies-neutralizing antibody titers were measured at predefined intervals. The primary outcome was the proportion of patients exhibiting protective antibody titers; secondary outcomes included RIG usage volume, adverse events, and feasibility in resource-limited settings. Both groups achieved adequate seroconversion with protective antibody titers. Wound-only RIG infiltration produced protective antibody responses comparable to weight-based RIG dosing while substantially reducing RIG volume used and could improve feasibility. Larger studies, including formal cost-effectiveness analyses, are needed to confirm the clinical and programmatic implications.
journal: The American Journal of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 狂犬病 是一种致命但可预防的人兽共患病,在印度每年导致超过 20,000 例死亡。本研究旨在评估仅伤口注射 狂犬病 免疫球蛋白(RIG)与基于体重的 RIG 剂量在 暴露后预防 中的非劣效性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本非劣效性临床试验纳入了 III 类 狂犬病 暴露的患者,所有患者均接受了标准的三剂 狂犬病 疫苗接种。主要结局是患者中出现保护性抗体滴度的比例;次要结局包括 RIG 使用量、不良事件以及在资源有限环境中的可行性。
elements_zh.methods: 在预设的时间间隔内测量血清 狂犬病 中和抗体滴度。狂犬病 免疫球蛋白通过基于体重或仅在伤口周围注射的方式给予。
elements_zh.main_results: 两组均实现了足够的血清转化并具有保护性抗体滴度。仅伤口 RIG 浸润产生的保护性抗体反应与基于体重的 RIG 剂量相当,同时大大减少了 RIG 的使用体积。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,仅伤口注射 RIG 在抗体反应方面与基于体重的剂量非劣效,这可能为资源分配和可行性提供潜在改进。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能有助于制定更高效、更具成本效益的 狂犬病 暴露后预防 策略,特别是在资源有限的环境中,减少 RIG 用量可能至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于其非随机设计以及依赖抗体滴度作为替代终点。证据强度中等,因为研究结果基于单一试验,且缺乏对临床结局的比较数据。

title: Targeted Liposomal Nanocarriers for High-Efficiency Neuronal mRNA Delivery
abstract: Purpose Messenger RNA therapeutics enable rapid, transient protein expression without risk of genomic integration, but their delivery to post-mitotic neurons remains challenging. Here, we present a neuron-targeted liposomal platform designed to enhance mRNA delivery efficiency in neurons. Methods We engineered DOTAP: DOPE liposomes to promote nucleic acid loading, stability, and endosomal escape, incorporated PEGylation to improve biocompatibility and circulation, and functionalized the liposome surface with a rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG)-derived peptide for neuronal targeting. We assessed particle size and surface charge, mRNA encapsulation/loading across different lipid: mRNA ratios, cytotoxicity in HEK293T cells as a function of cationic lipid content and PEGylation, and transfection performance in HEK293T cells and primary neurons, benchmarking against a commercial transfection reagent, with functional mRNA delivery further demonstrated in midbrain organoids following microinjection. Results The system enabled efficient mRNA encapsulation, maintained favorable particle size and surface charge characteristics, and supported low cytotoxicity. Across formulations, mRNA loading increased with lipid: mRNA ratio, with only modest reductions following PEGylation. In HEK293T cells, higher cationic lipid content increased its toxicity, whereas PEGylation reduced membrane interactions and improved tolerability. Transfection studies identified the 50:10 DOTAP: DOPE composition as optimal, yielding robust mRNA expression. In primary neurons, RVG-functionalized PEGylated liposomes containing 10 mol% DOPE achieved gene expression levels comparable to those of a commercial transfection reagent at a 10:1 lipid:mRNA ratio. Notably, incorporating 0.1% w/w RVG significantly outperformed the commercial formulation, yielding >30% gene-delivery efficiency in primary neuronal cultures. In midbrain organoids, the optimized mRNA-loaded RVG-functionalized liposomes produced GFP mRNA expression overlapping with NeuN staining, demonstrating functional mRNA delivery and translation within three-dimensional neural tissue. Conclusions Neuron-targeted DOTAP: DOPE liposomes incorporating the RVG peptide represent a promising mRNA delivery system for neurological applications, achieving a favorable balance of potency, safety, and specificity and supporting transient gene modulation in the central nervous system.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenge of delivering mRNA to post-mitotic neurons, which is critical for developing effective mRNA therapeutics for neurological applications. The background highlights that while mRNA therapeutics offer rapid and transient protein expression without genomic integration, achieving efficient delivery to neurons remains a significant hurdle.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the development and testing of a neuron-targeted liposomal platform designed to enhance mRNA delivery efficiency. The platform was evaluated in HEK293T cells, primary neurons, and midbrain organoids, with comparisons made to a commercial transfection reagent.
analysis.methods: The researchers engineered DOTAP: DOPE liposomes to improve nucleic acid loading, stability, and endosomal escape. They incorporated PEGylation for better biocompatibility and circulation and functionalized the liposome surface with a rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG)-derived peptide for neuronal targeting.
analysis.main_results: The system enabled efficient mRNA encapsulation, maintained favorable particle size and surface charge characteristics, and supported low cytotoxicity. Across formulations, mRNA loading increased with lipid:mRNA ratio, with only modest reductions following PEGylation. In HEK293T cells, higher cationic lipid content increased toxicity, whereas PEGylation reduced membrane interactions and improved tolerability.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that the optimized liposomal system achieves a favorable balance of potency, safety, and specificity for neuronal mRNA delivery, supporting transient gene modulation in the central nervous system. The use of RVG-functionalized liposomes represents a novel approach for targeted delivery in neurological contexts.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results have implications for the development of safe and effective mRNA delivery systems for neurological applications, potentially advancing treatments for diseases involving the central nervous system. The system's ability to deliver mRNA to midbrain organoids suggests its utility in studying and treating neurodegenerative conditions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro and in organoid models, which may not fully represent in vivo conditions. The evidence is based on abstract-only data, and the confidence in the findings is moderate due to the lack of detailed clinical or in vivo validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a novel liposomal platform designed to enhance mRNA delivery to neurons, addressing a critical challenge in mRNA therapeutics for neurological applications. The system was engineered with DOTAP: DOPE liposomes, PEGylation, and an RVG-derived peptide for targeting. Results showed efficient mRNA encapsulation, favorable particle characteristics, and low cytotoxicity. In HEK293T cells, higher cationic lipid content increased toxicity, but PEGylation improved tolerability. In primary neurons, the optimized liposomes achieved gene expression levels comparable to a commercial reagent. The system also demonstrated functional mRNA delivery in midbrain organoids, indicating potential for applications in neurodegenerative diseases. While the findings are promising, the study is limited to in vitro and organoid models, and the evidence is based on abstract-only data, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决将mRNA递送至终末分化的神经元的挑战,这对于开发有效的神经学应用mRNA治疗药物至关重要。背景指出,尽管mRNA治疗药物能够提供快速且短暂的蛋白质表达,而不会导致基因组整合,但实现mRNA向神经元的高效递送仍然是一个重大障碍。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及一种针对神经元的脂质体平台的开发与测试,旨在提高mRNA的递送效率。该平台在HEK293T细胞、原代神经元和中脑类器官中进行了评估,并与一种商业转染试剂进行了比较。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员设计了DOTAP: DOPE脂质体以提高核酸负载量、稳定性和内体逃逸能力。他们进行了PEG化处理以增强生物相容性和循环性,并在脂质体表面功能化了一种源自狂犬病病毒糖蛋白(RVG)的肽,用于神经元靶向。
elements_zh.main_results: 该系统实现了高效的mRNA封装,保持了有利的颗粒大小和表面电荷特性,并支持低细胞毒性。在不同配方中,mRNA负载量随着脂质与mRNA的比例增加而增加,PEG化后仅出现适度的降低。在HEK293T细胞中,较高的阳离子脂质含量会增加毒性,而PEG化则减少了膜相互作用并提高了耐受性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,优化的脂质体系统在神经元mRNA递送中实现了效力、安全性和特异性之间的良好平衡,支持中枢神经系统中的暂时基因调控。使用RVG功能化的脂质体代表了一种在神经学背景下的新型靶向递送方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果对开发安全有效的mRNA递送系统在神经学应用方面具有重要意义,可能推动治疗在涉及中枢神经系统的疾病中的发展。该系统能够将mRNA递送至中脑类器官,表明其在研究和治疗神经退行性疾病中的潜在用途。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于体外和类器官模型,这可能无法完全代表体内情况。所依据的证据基于摘要数据,由于缺乏详细的临床或体内验证,研究结果的可信度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决将mRNA递送至终末分化的神经元的挑战,这对于开发有效的神经学应用mRNA治疗药物至关重要。背景指出,尽管mRNA治疗药物能够提供快速且短暂的蛋白质表达,而不会导致基因组整合,但实现mRNA向神经元的高效递送仍然是一个重大障碍。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及一种针对神经元的脂质体平台的开发与测试,旨在提高mRNA的递送效率。该平台在HEK293T细胞、原代神经元和中脑类器官中进行了评估,并与一种商业转染试剂进行了比较。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员设计了DOTAP: DOPE脂质体以提高核酸负载量、稳定性和内体逃逸能力。他们进行了PEG化处理以增强生物相容性和循环性,并在脂质体表面功能化了一种源自狂犬病病毒糖蛋白(RVG)的肽,用于神经元靶向。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该系统实现了高效的mRNA封装,保持了有利的颗粒大小和表面电荷特性,并支持低细胞毒性。在不同配方中,mRNA负载量随着脂质与mRNA的比例增加而增加,PEG化后仅出现适度的降低。在HEK293T细胞中,较高的阳离子脂质含量会增加毒性,而PEG化则减少了膜相互作用并提高了耐受性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,优化的脂质体系统在神经元mRNA递送中实现了效力、安全性和特异性之间的良好平衡,支持中枢神经系统中的暂时基因调控。使用RVG功能化的脂质体代表了一种在神经学背景下的新型靶向递送方法。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果对开发安全有效的mRNA递送系统在神经学应用方面具有重要意义,可能推动治疗在涉及中枢神经系统的疾病中的发展。该系统能够将mRNA递送至中脑类器官,表明其在研究和治疗神经退行性疾病中的潜在用途。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于体外和类器官模型,这可能无法完全代表体内情况。所依据的证据基于摘要数据,由于缺乏详细的临床或体内验证,研究结果的可信度中等。

title: Application Research on mRNA Vaccine Technology in Infectious Disease Prevention and Control
abstract: Compared with inactivated, subunit, and DNA nucleic-acid approaches, mRNA vaccines do not enter the nucleus and carry no risk of genomic integration; they are translated in the cytoplasm and can jointly induce humoral and cellular immunity. In vitro transcription and cell-free production also markedly shorten the interval from sequence acquisition to vaccine output. This paper summarizes the configurations of non-replicating, self-amplifying, and circular RNA vaccines, as well as the characteristics of PRR-mediated immune activation, and reviews key process technologies including the 5′ cap, UTRs, pseudouridine modification, dsRNA removal, and LNP delivery. At the application level, the discussion centers on the billion-scale administration of SARS-CoV-2 mRNA vaccines, booster immunization, and variant-component updating, while also reviewing progress and limitations in pipelines for influenza, rabies post-exposure prophylaxis, HIV, hepatitis B, and other diseases, and analyzing their public health significance in shortening emergency response windows and tracking strain drift. IVT purity, ultracold-chain requirements, and accessibility in resource-limited regions remain the main constraints. Self-amplifying/circular RNA, multivalent combination vaccines, and inhalable mucosal delivery may help move this platform from a “single pandemic response” toward broader infectious disease prevention and control practice.
journal: International Journal of Public Health and Medical Research

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on rabies virus and rabies disease. It examines the application of mRNA vaccine technology in the prevention and control of rabies, including its potential for broader use in infectious disease management.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative summary of mRNA vaccine technology, discussing its configurations, immune activation mechanisms, and key process technologies. It does not explicitly report on databases, search dates, or meta-analysis methods.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: mRNA vaccines for rabies are non-replicating, do not integrate into the genome, and can induce both humoral and cellular immunity. They are translated in the cytoplasm and offer advantages over traditional nucleic-acid approaches.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights limitations in mRNA vaccine technology, such as IVT purity, ultracold-chain requirements, and accessibility in resource-limited regions. It also notes the need for further development in pipelines for other diseases like influenza, rabies post-exposure prophylaxis, and HIV.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that advancements in self-amplifying/circular RNA, multivalent combination vaccines, and inhalable mucosal delivery could expand mRNA vaccines from pandemic responses to broader infectious disease prevention. It also emphasizes the importance of addressing production and distribution challenges for effective rabies control.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the application of mRNA vaccine technology in rabies prevention and control. It highlights the advantages of mRNA vaccines, such as their non-genomic integration and ability to induce both humoral and cellular immunity. The paper summarizes the configurations of non-replicating, self-amplifying, and circular RNA vaccines, as well as key process technologies like 5′ cap, UTRs, pseudouridine modification, dsRNA removal, and LNP delivery. It also discusses the practical challenges of mRNA vaccine production, including IVT purity, ultracold-chain requirements, and accessibility in resource-limited regions. The review emphasizes the potential of mRNA vaccines to move beyond pandemic responses and into broader infectious disease prevention, suggesting future research directions such as self-amplifying RNA, multivalent vaccines, and mucosal delivery methods.

title: Microbiological safety assessment of canine adipose derived mesenchymal stem cell preparations reveal no detectable contamination
abstract: The experimental application of canine adipose-derived mesenchymal stem/stromal cells (cAD-MSC) has demonstrated excellent therapeutic potential in the treatment of a number of previously untreatable or difficult-to-treat diseases. However, the production of cAD-MSC for clinical application necessitates in vitro isolation and cell expansion, introducing the risk of microbiological contamination. Studies indicate that stored MSCs may be contaminated with bacteria, fungi, or viruses, resulting in cell transformation, cell death, or persistent infection. This ultimately compromises therapeutic efficacy and potentially facilitates therapy-induced pathogen transmission. In accordance with the European Medicines Agency guidelines mandating sterility testing as an integral component of the manufacturing process, this study aimed to assess the sterility of the cAD-MSC bank at the Croatian Veterinary Institute. To test for the most clinically significant canine pathogens, nucleic acids were extracted from 32 cAD-MSC preparations and analyzed using standard molecular PCR methods. The pathogen screening panel included rabies virus (Lyssavirus), canine herpesvirus (Varicellovirus canidalpha1), parvovirus (Carnivore protoparvovirus 1), coronavirus (Alphacoronavirus 1), distemper virus (Morbillivirus canis), Rotavirus A, Leptospira spp, Brucella canis, Borrelia burgdorferi sensu lato, Anaplasma spp, Ehrlichia spp, Mycoplasma spp (hemotropic), and Neospora caninum. No tested gene fragments of the aforementioned pathogens were detected, indicating that the cAD-MSC preparations were free from the presence of clinically significant pathogens. Rigorous implementation of sterility control during the cell isolation and expansion process is essential to ensure safe cell-based therapy in canine patients.
